gate_criteria.description: One player-safe support ID can be traced across API/Core/DB/worker without exposing secrets; critical failure and recovery alerts actually arrive
verified_points: Player-safe support ID generation (MX-[A-Z0-9]{4}-[A-Z0-9]{4}) and trace context propagation across services.
Zero secret or OTP leakage in formatted structured JSON logs across passwords, tokens, cookies, auth headers, and private keys.
Role-specific health probes (livez, readyz, opsz): opsz appropriately fails when backups are stale (>24h), worker loop is stalled (>60s), or DLQ > 0, while process livez remains ok.
Prometheus metrics collector and text exposition format supporting counters, gauges, and latency histograms.
Private support incident triage tool resolving incident details by support ID without exposing PII.
